hook.en: In 1946 Malay rulers boycotted a governor's installation and Malays wore white bands on their songkok for seven days, as if mourning. What was so dangerous about a plan called the Malayan Union?
hook.bm: Pada 1946, raja-raja Melayu memulaukan istiadat pelantikan gabenor dan orang Melayu memakai kain putih di songkok selama tujuh hari, seolah-olah berkabung. Apakah yang begitu berbahaya tentang rancangan bernama Malayan Union?

bigIdeas.en: After WWII the British returned with the BMA and planned tighter, centralised control.
bigIdeas.bm: Selepas Perang Dunia Kedua, British kembali dengan BMA dan merancang kawalan yang lebih ketat dan berpusat.

bigIdeas.en: The Malayan Union (1 April 1946) reduced the rulers' power and offered citizenship by jus soli.
bigIdeas.bm: Malayan Union (1 April 1946) mengurangkan kuasa raja dan menawarkan kerakyatan jus soli.

bigIdeas.en: United Malay opposition led to UMNO (11 May 1946) and forced the British to replace the Union.
bigIdeas.bm: Penentangan Melayu yang bersatu membawa kepada UMNO (11 Mei 1946) dan memaksa British menggantikan Malayan Union.

bigIdeas.en: Sarawak and Sabah became British Crown Colonies in 1946, which also met resistance.
bigIdeas.bm: Sarawak dan Sabah menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota British pada 1946, yang juga ditentang.

cells.bm: Hanya agama Islam dan adat Melayu

cells.en: Jus soli — open to all born here
cells.bm: Jus soli — terbuka kepada semua yang lahir di sini

cells.en: FMS, UMS and Straits Settlements separate
9 states + Penang + Melaka united; Singapore separate
cells.bm: 9 negeri + Pulau Pinang + Melaka disatukan; Singapura berasingan

definition.en: British plan uniting the Malay states, Penang and Melaka under a Governor (1 April 1946).
definition.bm: Rancangan British menyatukan negeri Melayu, Pulau Pinang dan Melaka di bawah seorang Gabenor (1 April 1946).

definition.en: Citizenship based on place of birth.
British envoy who obtained the rulers' signatures for the Malayan Union in 1945.
definition.bm: Wakil British yang mendapatkan tandatangan raja-raja untuk Malayan Union pada 1945.

definition.en: United Malays National Organisation, founded 11 May 1946, led by Dato' Onn Jaafar.
definition.bm: Pertubuhan Kebangsaan Melayu Bersatu, ditubuhkan 11 Mei 1946, dipimpin Dato' Onn Jaafar.

definition.en: A territory ruled directly by the British government.
definition.bm: Wilayah yang diperintah secara langsung oleh kerajaan British.

question.en: Why did the Malays oppose the Malayan Union? Give TWO reasons. (4 marks)
question.bm: Mengapakah orang Melayu menentang Malayan Union? Berikan DUA sebab. (4 markah)

steps.en: Reason 1: the rulers' power was reduced to matters of Islam and Malay custom only.
steps.bm: Sebab 1: kuasa raja dikurangkan kepada hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu sahaja.

steps.en: Reason 2: citizenship by jus soli was seen as threatening Malay political position.
steps.bm: Sebab 2: kerakyatan jus soli dianggap mengancam kedudukan politik orang Melayu.

answer.en: Also accept: MacMichael used threats to get signatures; no consultation with the people.
answer.bm: Terima juga: MacMichael menggunakan ugutan untuk mendapat tandatangan; rakyat tidak dirunding.

prompt.en: After Japan surrendered, the British first governed through the…
prompt.bm: Selepas Jepun menyerah, British mula-mula memerintah melalui…

explanation.en: The BMA ruled from September 1945 to March 1946.
explanation.bm: BMA memerintah dari September 1945 hingga Mac 1946.

prompt.en: When was the Malayan Union officially introduced?
prompt.bm: Bilakah Malayan Union diperkenalkan secara rasmi?

explanation.en: The Malayan Union began on 1 April 1946.
explanation.bm: Malayan Union bermula pada 1 April 1946.

prompt.en: Who obtained the Malay rulers' signatures for the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mendapatkan tandatangan raja-raja Melayu untuk Malayan Union?

explanation.en: MacMichael visited each ruler between October and December 1945.
explanation.bm: MacMichael melawat setiap raja antara Oktober dan Disember 1945.

prompt.en: Citizenship based on place of birth is called jus ______.
prompt.bm: Kerakyatan berdasarkan tempat lahir dipanggil jus ______.

explanation.en: Jus soli = right of the soil.
explanation.bm: Jus soli = hak berdasarkan tempat lahir.

prompt.en: Which territory was NOT included in the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Wilayah manakah yang TIDAK termasuk dalam Malayan Union?

explanation.en: Singapore was kept as a separate colony.
explanation.bm: Singapura dikekalkan sebagai tanah jajahan berasingan.

prompt.en: UMNO was founded on 11 May 1946. Who was its first president?
prompt.bm: UMNO ditubuhkan pada 11 Mei 1946. Siapakah presiden pertamanya?

explanation.en: Dato' Onn Jaafar led UMNO in opposing the Malayan Union.
explanation.bm: Dato' Onn Jaafar memimpin UMNO menentang Malayan Union.

prompt.en: The first Pan-Malayan Malay Congress (March 1946) was held at the Sultan ______ Club, Kampung Baru.
prompt.bm: Kongres Melayu Se-Malaya pertama (Mac 1946) diadakan di Kelab Sultan ______, Kampung Baru.

explanation.en: Kelab Sultan Sulaiman in Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur.
explanation.bm: Kelab Sultan Sulaiman di Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur.

prompt.en: Sarawak and Sabah became British Crown Colonies in…
prompt.bm: Sarawak dan Sabah menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota British pada…

explanation.en: Both became Crown Colonies in July 1946.
explanation.bm: Kedua-duanya menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota pada Julai 1946.

prompt.en: Select ALL features of the Malayan Union.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA ciri Malayan Union.

explanation.en: The Malayan Union centralised British control; it did not give independence.
explanation.bm: Malayan Union memusatkan kawalan British; ia tidak memberi kemerdekaan.

options.en: Rulers' power limited to Islam and Malay custom
options.bm: Kuasa raja terhad kepada agama Islam dan adat Melayu

prompt.en: Why did the British want the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah British mahu Malayan Union?

explanation.en: A single central government made rule easier and cheaper after the war.
explanation.bm: Satu kerajaan pusat memudahkan dan menjimatkan pemerintahan selepas perang.

options.en: To make administration cheaper and more efficient under central control
options.bm: Untuk menjimatkan dan mencekapkan pentadbiran di bawah kawalan pusat

options.en: To give power to the rulers

prompt.en: How did the Malays show their protest against the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah orang Melayu menunjukkan bantahan terhadap Malayan Union?

explanation.en: The protests were peaceful but united.
explanation.bm: Bantahan dibuat secara aman tetapi bersatu.

options.en: Wearing white bands on their songkok and boycotting the Governor's installation
options.bm: Memakai kain putih di songkok dan memulaukan istiadat pelantikan Gabenor

prompt.en: Which group of British people ALSO opposed the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Golongan British manakah yang JUGA menentang Malayan Union?

explanation.en: Former officers like Swettenham and Winstedt said it broke treaties with the rulers.
explanation.bm: Bekas pegawai seperti Swettenham dan Winstedt berkata ia melanggar perjanjian dengan raja.

options.en: Retired British officers such as Frank Swettenham
options.bm: Bekas pegawai British seperti Frank Swettenham

prompt.en: Arrange these events in time order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa ini mengikut kronologi.

explanation.en: Oct–Dec 1945 → March 1946 → 1 April 1946 → 11 May 1946.
explanation.bm: Okt–Dis 1945 → Mac 1946 → 1 April 1946 → 11 Mei 1946.

prompt.en: Who assassinated Governor Duncan Stewart of Sarawak in 1949 in protest against cession?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang membunuh Gabenor Duncan Stewart di Sarawak pada 1949 kerana menentang penyerahan?

explanation.en: Rosli Dhobi, of the Rukun 13 group, stabbed Stewart in Sibu on 3 December 1949.
explanation.bm: Rosli Dhobi, ahli Rukun 13, menikam Stewart di Sibu pada 3 Disember 1949.

prompt.en: Why was Sabah handed to the British Crown in 1946?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Sabah diserahkan kepada Kerajaan British pada 1946?

explanation.en: War damage was too costly for the company, so the Crown took over.
explanation.bm: Kerosakan perang terlalu mahal bagi syarikat itu, jadi Kerajaan British mengambil alih.

options.en: The British North Borneo Company could not afford to rebuild after the war
options.bm: Syarikat Borneo Utara British tidak mampu membangunkan semula selepas perang

prompt.en: Who was the Governor of the Malayan Union?
prompt.bm: Siapakah Gabenor Malayan Union?

explanation.en: Sir Edward Gent was installed as Governor in April 1946.
explanation.bm: Sir Edward Gent dilantik sebagai Gabenor pada April 1946.

prompt.en: What was the MOST significant result of the anti-Malayan Union movement?
prompt.bm: Apakah hasil PALING penting gerakan anti-Malayan Union?

explanation.en: UMNO's unity led to the Federation of Malaya 1948 and set the path to independence.
explanation.bm: Perpaduan UMNO membawa kepada Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1948 dan membuka jalan kemerdekaan.

options.en: Malays united under one political body and forced the British to negotiate
options.bm: Orang Melayu bersatu di bawah satu badan politik dan memaksa British berunding
Tanah Melayu menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota

prompt.en: Why was jus soli citizenship seen as a threat by the Malays in 1946?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah kerakyatan jus soli dianggap ancaman oleh orang Melayu pada 1946?

explanation.en: Combined with weaker rulers, the Malays feared losing their political standing.
explanation.bm: Digabungkan dengan kuasa raja yang lemah, orang Melayu bimbang kehilangan kedudukan politik.

options.en: Large numbers could gain citizenship quickly, affecting the political position of the Malays
options.bm: Ramai boleh mendapat kerakyatan dengan cepat, menjejaskan kedudukan politik orang Melayu

options.en: It was only for the British

prompt.en: Which lesson from the Malayan Union protest is relevant today?
prompt.bm: Pengajaran manakah daripada bantahan Malayan Union yang relevan hari ini?

explanation.en: The protest succeeded without bloodshed through unity and organisation.
explanation.bm: Bantahan berjaya tanpa pertumpahan darah melalui perpaduan dan organisasi.

options.en: Peaceful, united action can change government policy
options.bm: Tindakan aman dan bersatu boleh mengubah dasar kerajaan

prompt.en: Compare the reactions in Malaya and Sarawak to the 1946 changes.
prompt.bm: Bandingkan reaksi di Tanah Melayu dan Sarawak terhadap perubahan 1946.

explanation.en: Anti-cession groups in Sarawak protested, and Rosli Dhobi killed Governor Stewart in 1949.
explanation.bm: Kumpulan antipenyerahan di Sarawak membantah, dan Rosli Dhobi membunuh Gabenor Stewart pada 1949.

options.en: Both opposed British changes; Malaya mainly peacefully, Sarawak also saw an assassination
options.bm: Kedua-duanya menentang perubahan British; Tanah Melayu kebanyakannya aman, Sarawak turut menyaksikan pembunuhan
